description: This file defines a singleton class 'SettingsWindowOpener' responsible for opening the settings window in a macOS application. It includes protocols for menu actions and handles fallback mechanisms to ensure the settings window opens appropriately.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class managing the presentation of the settings window, with methods to register a custom action and trigger the window opening.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Stores a closure that is invoked to open the settings window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Activates the app and attempts to open the settings window via a registered action, or falls back to menu item selectors.
